$comment: Network fault matrix for the M0/M1 acceptance tests. The authoritative copy of these values lives in server/cmd/game/netsim_test.go (TestNetworkConditionsMatrix). tools/check-test-assets.py fails if this file drifts from the Go source.

simulation.model: application-level netem over a real WebSocket
simulation.one_way_delay: rtt_ms / 2 applied to both write and read
simulation.loss: frames dropped independently with probability p_loss, never reordered by the simulator itself

invariants: both clients converge to identical cell ownership for every profile
scores are identical on both clients for every profile
no client-side value is ever authoritative: only server snapshots decide
